name.zh: AI 品牌封面三联卡片

description.en: Three portrait covers for Claude, Codex and Cursor, with user-selected artwork, real SVG brand marks and independent Chinese captions.
description.zh: Claude、Codex、Cursor 三张竖版封面，保留选定配图、真实 SVG 标志与独立中文介绍。

keywords: AI Claude Codex Cursor 品牌 封面 三联 卡片 海报

discovery.caveat: 展示卡片，不调用真实 AI 服务；品牌标志不代表官方合作。

source.implementation: LeiBox native implementation reusing the existing poster-card lifecycle and interaction core.
source.license: User-supplied artwork. Claude and Cursor marks follow their brand terms; Codex vectors retain the bundled Lobe Icons MIT notice. No affiliation implied.

notice.en: Complete source files from this project's existing framework package. Preserve included notices and reference attribution.
notice.zh: 提供本站已有框架代码包的完整文件，保留源码声明与设计参考署名。

instructions.en: Hover or focus a cover to reveal its image response. Click to select; arrow keys move focus and Escape clears the selection.
instructions.zh: 悬停或聚焦查看图片反馈，点击选择；方向键移动焦点，Escape 清空选择。
